hypothesis: The admitted local-combat representation has not yielded a useful direct gain/tie/loss policy. Test a shared utility comparator that forces identical-action expected difference to zero, reverses gain/loss when compared actions are swapped, and removes a free utility offset.
model: Same6146 public paired inputs and128/64 encoder, with2 outputs per action:utility and tie level. Score each alternative and reference under the SAME actual parent recommendation. Class logits are[-(u_a-u_b),(t_a+t_b)/2,u_a-u_b]. Deploy P(gain)-P(loss). Parent-reference score is zero by construction.
initialization: Reuse each E165 admitted5000-step inner/final auxiliary encoder with its original family roles. Reset the2-output head to zero; perform zero additional auxiliary updates. Input-weight restrictions are removed as in E165 Heart fitting.
labels: Same22311 nonparent comparisons on7448 branch states. Exact observed graph return difference supplies loss/tie/gain labels. No replacement of missing outcomes by losses and no hidden/RNG/future features.
selection: Same family sampler, three outer folds, inner family partition,8192 fixed validation draws, categorical validation loss and eight E160 checkpoints. No later-checkpoint selection from outer results.
branch_gate: Keep E160 stopping, sampling, inputs, categorical support, terminal gain/tie/loss labels and P(gain)-P(loss) deployment. Required fit known gains at least half of available improvements, fit gains greater than losses, held gains greater than losses. Unknown actions remain unknown.
natural_evaluation: Only after independent training review and the unchanged branch gate:128 fixed historical pilot families, each excluded from its fold model. Compare with the frozen parent, require net gain>=8 and exact paired p<.025, zero faults, all outside choices/state/RNG audited and every winning trajectory freshly replanned. This is not the untouched1024-seed final acceptance.
limits: This is a structured classifier using an admitted encoder, not a claim that the previous unconstrained classifier caused every failure. E148 within-state squared regression and prior stopping/data-expansion failures remain recorded. No new training sampling, auxiliary training or automatic adoption.
